top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a simple, completely new principle, recruiting an E3 ligase with a small molecule to remove a chosen protein, that has been reproduced widely and is already used as a research tool. Crews and Deshaies hold the concept and first proof of principle, and Ciulli's VHL ligands and ternary-complex cooperativity analysis made it quantitative and rational. The reservations are real (no broadly approved degrader, Sakamoto, Kim, Handa, Ito and Gray left out), but a narrowly worded citation on degradation by designed recruitment is defensible. P002 is mature with clean two-name credit but extends a principle recognised in 2010, so it ranks second, and still above no award.
